Current main Final.no_four_mubs still has AtlasCertificate input. It is not imported as a justification of infeasibility.

TaoQuartetTerminal imports a circle certificate and is not adopted/replayed. CriticalNonzeroComplementarySheet needs special critical-parameter hypotheses. transport_closure.proof: Ha Kab=conj(Sab00) Hb, Hb Kab*=Sab00 Ha from Ha Ha*=Hb Hb*=6I and the lift definition. K01 K12 is proportional to K02 by H1 H1*=6I. Since K02[0,0]=1, its proportionality factor is (K01 K12)[0,0].
